definitions.explanation: A political and economic theory advocating collective or governmental ownership and administration of the means of production.

examples.japanese: {社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ}{国家|こっか}。
{社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ}の{理念|りねん}。
{社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ}と{資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}の{違|ちが}い。
examples.english: The difference between socialism and capitalism.

notes:
{社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ} refers to socialism as a political and economic ideology advocating collective ownership.

WORD FORMATION:
{社会|しゃかい} (society) + {主義|しゅぎ} (ideology, -ism)

RELATED IDEOLOGIES:
- {資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}: capitalism (contrast)
- {共産主義|きょうさんしゅぎ}: communism
- {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}: democracy
- {自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}: liberalism

DERIVED TERMS:
- {社会主義者|しゃかいしゅぎしゃ}: socialist (person)
- {社会主義的|しゃかいしゅぎてき}: socialistic
- {社会主義{国家|こっか}}: socialist state

HISTORICAL NOTE:
{社会党|しゃかいとう} (Socialist Party) was a major political party in postwar Japan until 1996.
